== Biography ==
{{Scotland Sticker}}

===Birth===
John was born in 1641.  He was Christened on 24 October 1641 in Kirkcaldy, Fife, Scotland <ref> "Scotland Births and Baptism, 1564 - 1950," database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY83-59V : 11 February 2020), John Gray, 1641. </ref> He is the son of [[Gray-27221|John Gray]] and [Beans-140|Kathren Beans]].

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns John Gray. The banns/marriage index records Marion Glasgow and John Gray on 30 September 1686 at Carriden.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 664/10 / 109; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
